subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR remove `models.providers.*.retry`, fully implement its runtime retry behavior, or intentionally accept a schema-only retry surface?
rationale: The PR adds a public provider config surface that changes operator expectations and overlaps the canonical LLM retry/backoff product/API discussion, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep the public retry contract on the canonical retry issue while the timeout change is proven independently.

options.title: Implement Retry Now
options.body: Wire provider retry into the model-call path with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline updates, and focused runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause For Retry Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch until maintainers settle the public retry/backoff contract and its provider-vs-agent scope.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep the public retry contract on the canonical retry issue while the timeout change is proven independently.
